text: This report recommends that the name "Galipo Brothers Lane" be approved to identify an existing public lane located north of College Street, extending between Crawford Street and Montrose Street. Community Councils have delegated authority to decide street naming matters which comply with the City of Toronto Street Naming Policy.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Approved the name "Galipo Brothers Lane" for an existing public lane located north of College Street, extending between Crawford Street and Montrose Street.
